The mandatory caller, ordering, fallback, and focused-equivalence conditions below are part of this GO.

diagnosisAttribution.reportedFinding: Canonical save identity succeeds; the only projection differences are defensive_power and defense_per_edge for ten RBiH sectors, caused by a fresh load computing ratings before terrain sets are primed.
diagnosisAttribution.reviewLimit: This preimplementation review accepts the bounded diagnosis as an input and independently verifies that the proposed call-graph repair satisfies canon and determinism. It does not re-run or duplicate the diagnosis.

reviewedSource.finding: loadStateFromPath currently computes sector ratings without terrain priming; advanceTurn replaces both terrain globals from explicit baseDir before BotManager, prediction, and runTurn.
The existing loaders accept baseDir and retain deterministic empty-set fallback for missing or malformed files.
Both production save-load routes call loadStateFromPath without getBaseDir.
The authoritative loaded-projection builder selects a source or packaged desktop bundle but calls loadStateFromPath without the corresponding explicit data root.
Two additional loadStateFromPath callers already possess baseDir and must pass it if the loader signature becomes explicit-root.

mandatoryImplementationBounds: Create one idempotent primeCombatTerrain(baseDir) operation that loads and replaces both urban and forest global sets on every call. It must not union with, retain, or conditionally reuse ambient process state.
Call primeCombatTerrain(baseDir) in loadStateFromPath after deserialization and before computeSectorCombatRatings.
Call the same helper in advanceTurn at its current ordering point before BotManager construction, operation prediction, combat prediction, or runTurn. Moving it later is outside this approval.

Make loadStateFromPath's data root explicit. All repository callers must pass the correct root. The reviewed call inventory is two Electron routes, the native authoritative projection builder, two desktop_calibration_compare calls, and three tracked tests. A default process.cwd fallback on the production load path would preserve the process-history defect and is not approved.

Electron's two load routes must pass getBaseDir(). The native expected builder must pass repository root for the source bundle and packaged resources root for the packaged bundle, derived from the selected bundle rather than ambient CWD.
Preserve existing missing/malformed terrain-file behavior: both globals are replaced with the loader result, including empty sets. Do not silently retain a previous valid root.

Do not add GameState fields, serialize sector_combat_ratings, alter canonical save bytes, modify terrain assets/multipliers/combat formulas, change cache ordering beyond prerequisite priming, or change player controls, thresholds, policy, history, or geometry.
The harness must use the production loadStateFromPath implementation. Duplicating terrain or rating logic in the observer is outside this approval.

checks: RED/GREEN reproduction of the retained mismatch using a fresh process or reset module state and a complete explicit root containing canonical map, urban, and forest inputs.
Cold load and warm load of the same canonical save and root yield exactly equal runtime sector_combat_ratings and player-visible projection.
Prime root A, then load using distinct root B; the result equals a fresh root-B process and proves both globals were replaced rather than merged or reused.
Missing and malformed root cases deterministically install empty sets and cannot inherit stale values from an earlier valid root.
serializeState of every loaded state remains byte-identical to the input canonical save.
From the same save and complete root, cold-load-plus-next-advance and warm-load-plus-next-advance produce byte-identical canonical state and report, including operations, battles, and controls.
Production caller tests bind both Electron load sites to getBaseDir, both desktop_calibration_compare sites to baseDir, and source/package expected-builder roots to the selected bundle location.
Existing desktop terrain-prerequisite and persisted-sector-continuity tests remain green; run the focused desktop load/terrain/caller tests and TypeScript typecheck.
requiredFocusedValidation.passCriteria: All focused checks pass with zero failed tests and zero type errors; canonical save bytes are unchanged; next-advance state/report are byte-identical; no caller relies on CWD or prior globals.
requiredFocusedValidation.stopCondition: Any next-advance difference, save-byte difference, terrain-data or multiplier change, new serialized field, or scenario-runner change invalidates the desktop-only classification. Stop before package/native and require a new canon review plus fresh full suite and 188-week qualification.
